- Fixed a crash on Samsung / Android 17: a text field asked the clipboard if it could paste while the accessibility service read the screen, and a phone that denies the app the clipboard ended the app (SecurityException READ_CLIPBOARD); the fields now see an empty clipboard then.
- Each app on its own has a first-start setup screen of its own that asks only for what that app needs (Files: all files access; Calendar: calendar; Contacts: contacts and calls; Messages: SMS and the default messages app; Music: songs, Bluetooth; Video: videos and the small window; Keyboard: turn it on, use it, microphone, one-time codes; Launcher: home app and more; Island, Notification history, Game Hub, Clock, Health, Weather, Voice … each its own), all optional.
